You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Walt Fischer. Rail conductor. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Grandma's Tin Cup, Dispatcher's headset, Photo album, Trail compass, Spare Socks. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people.
